title: Per Aspera
provenance: Reported by violet-black (highball-db#1336, 2026-11-19), Apple M5 Max, macOS 26.6.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 91 minutes: the GOG copy, as the player said the next day (highball-db#1336, 2026-11-20). The page carries the Steam release's id. The environment's DLL overrides (d3d9, d3dx9d_28 and dsound, native first) are left from the player's NWN2 setup, and in the player's words this game doesn't use them. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Tlön Industries' 2020 game about terraforming Mars. Reported perfect on an M5 Max with DXMT on the default engine r28 over 91 minutes. The GOG copy, per the player, who adds that it needs none of the DLL overrides that environment had from another game.
